item.title: Fire reported at Princeton Towers, multiple agencies respond
item.description: PRINCETON, WV (WVNS) - Mercer County 911 received a call of a fire at the Princeton Towers on Stafford Drive on Sunday, February 15, 2026. Multiple agencies responded and the Princeton Fire Department reported the fire was extinguished. Their main focus is now evacuating everyone safely, according to Mercer County 911.
